week_review.review_text:
WHAT HAPPENED:
The engine correctly called the weekly trend, with ES falling 1.51% overall. However, counter-trend recoveries on Wednesday and Friday reduced daily directional agreement to 3 out of 5 days.

WHY IT MISSED:
The engine assigned High confidence despite clear signal conflict in the data. While the macro baseline remained net short, commercials actually covered 58,064 short contracts that week, aligned with a recent bullish nodule. The system treated absolute net short levels as strongly bearish while ignoring significant week-over-week short covering, causing it to overstate confidence and fail to anticipate mid-week buying pressure.

SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENT:
Consider reviewing a rule change that automatically caps confidence at Medium whenever week-over-week commercial short covering exceeds 30,000 contracts while a bullish nodule is active.

SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENT:
When commercial net positioning reaches a multi-year extreme and a bearish nodule is present, introduce a weighting factor to increase the probability of intra-week rotational or pullback days, even within a strong directional bias.

week_review.review_text:
WHAT HAPPENED:
The bias engine issued a high-confidence bearish call on the Nasdaq-100, but the index rallied aggressively to close up +4.45% on the week.

WHY IT MISSED:
The engine assigned high confidence despite structural conflict across lookback windows. While commercial net shorts expanded over two weeks into the lower 64% of the 6-month range, positioning remained in the upper 64% of the 12-month range. Mistaking minor short-term commercial hedging for a high-confidence sell program while the broader 12-month regime was not aligned led the system to call a reversal against strong prevailing market expansion.

SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENT:
Consider adding a rule that automatically caps confidence at Low or Neutral whenever the 6-month and 12-month percentile ranks conflict, requiring alignment across both timeframes before a High confidence bias can trigger.

The engine issued a High confidence Strongly Bearish bias on ES, but price rose +0.39% over the week. Strong rebounds on Thursday (+134) and Friday (+40) completely erased the midweek decline.
